frontier.name: Takeuchi's theorem for `G ⧸ N`.
frontier.text: Over a field, the projection onto the coinvariants must be shown faithfully flat with kernel exactly `N`. Then `G ⧸ N` represents the fppf quotient sheaf, and every normal subgroup sits in a short exact sequence.

frontier.name: Chevalley's theorem, line form, and representable quotients.
frontier.text: The subspace stabilizer has to become the stabilizer of a line in an exterior power. Exterior powers are now subcomodules, so what remains is the top-degree argument, then representability of `G/H` and affineness when `H` is reductive.

frontier.name: Conjugacy of Borels and root data in general.
frontier.text: Geometric conjugacy is needed for an arbitrary smooth connected group; so far it is known, as containment in a conjugate of the upper-triangular group, only for `GLₙ` and `SLₙ`. It blocks extracting the root datum of an arbitrary reductive group and identifying `N(T)/T` with its Weyl group.

frontier.name: The unipotent radical.
frontier.text: It remains to prove that the connected normal smooth unipotent subgroup is maximal in general. The present criteria only recognise it.

frontier.name: The pinned isomorphism theorem.
frontier.text: Uniqueness of automorphisms with given action on root subgroups is proved carrier by carrier. Existence for an arbitrary isomorphism of root data is still missing, as is the identification of each carrier with the pinned simply connected group of its type.

status.glance: Four layers are done: the three-way group-scheme dictionary, representation theory, the Lie algebra, and tori with Jordan decomposition. Subgroups and quotients, radicals, reductivity, structure theory and the explicit pinned carriers are partial. Classification has not begun.

frontier.text: : show that finite representation type forces a positive definite Tits form. status.glance: Root systems, semisimple algebras and compact groups are complete, the last including character completeness on top of Peter–Weyl. Gabriel's theorem, Ado–Iwasawa, Schur–Weyl duality, the spin fundamentals and the modular Artin theorem are partial. Triality has not begun, and neither have the Lie-group layers from Lie's third theorem onward.

status.glance: Every part of the roadmap is done. The Hermite functions and the Chebyshev polynomials are complete orthonormal bases of their `L²` spaces. The Hermite basis also has its two main structural consequences: it diagonalizes the `L²` Fourier transform, and on Schwartz space it carries the ladder operators. frontier.text: The covering isomorphism gives `π_k(RPⁿ) ≅ π_k(Sⁿ)` for `k ≥ 2`, but nothing here computes `π_n(Sⁿ)`; that needs a degree or Hurewicz argument, and neither appears here.

frontier.text: The standing local hypotheses are shown to be exactly what a simply connected cover requires, so the classification cannot be pushed further as stated; spaces failing them would need a different notion of cover, and nothing here attempts one.

status.glance: Every stage of the roadmap has its stated targets proved. The universal cover is constructed, subgroups of `π₁(X, x₀)` classify connected covers in both pointed and unpointed form, covers are classified categorically with `π₁(X, x₀)` recovered as the automorphisms of the fibre functor, and the application list (`π₁(S¹)`, `π_n(S¹)`, tori, `K(G, 1)` recognition, `RPⁿ`) is complete. What remains lies beyond the roadmap's text: computing higher homotopy groups, and bases without a universal cover.
